page.notes: Running head is given without "Cap. 5.", which is the chapter number and not part of the title. Marks: "p", "f", "t" and "sect" are in the margin and in the text as printed; their pairing is read from position and is doubtful. The asterisks in the text stand for two separate reference marks, and the first note with "Supra" is read as "Supra." with no section number. The reading "serua-" at the end of the quotation is uncertain (the scan looks like "ferua" or "serua"). "Sect. XV." is a margin marker, not a heading. "Epist." at the foot is taken as the catchword. The printed quotation marks « are kept as printed. The "Baron." note reads "n. 7." as printed.
